title: Is finding a depth-first-search tree in deterministic NC?
formal: Can a deterministic algorithm construct some valid depth-first-search forest of every finite undirected graph in polylogarithmic parallel time using polynomially many processors?
context:
No prescribed neighbor order is required. Computing the exact traversal induced by a supplied order is a different, harder formulation.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Asks whether the search structure produced by an apparently sequential graph traversal can be computed efficiently in parallel.
